en.title: Turkish Air Force AS532 helicopter crashes on training flight, killing all five aboard
en.summary: A Turkish Air Force AS532 helicopter crashed in northwestern Turkey on November 24 during a training flight, killing all five soldiers aboard. The cause of the crash is not yet known.
body: A Turkish Air Force helicopter crashed in northwestern Turkey on November 24 during a training flight, killing all five soldiers on board, according to the Turkish Defense Ministry. The helicopter had taken off in Eskisehir Province before coming down, and search and rescue teams found the wreckage of an AS532 helicopter at the scene. The ministry confirmed that all five soldiers aboard were killed, and the cause of the crash is not yet known.

The crash was the second Turkish military helicopter accident in about two weeks. On November 12, an S-70 military helicopter crashed in Malatya Province in eastern Turkey, killing all four soldiers on board.

facts.claim: A Turkish Air Force AS532 helicopter crashed in Eskisehir Province in northwestern Turkey on November 24 during a training flight, killing all five soldiers aboard.
Search and rescue teams found the wreckage of the AS532 helicopter, and the Turkish Defense Ministry confirmed all five soldiers aboard were killed; the cause is not yet known.
It was the second Turkish military helicopter accident in about two weeks, after an S-70 crashed in Malatya Province on November 12, killing four soldiers.

zh.title: 土耳其空軍AS-532直升機訓練飛行墜毀、5名軍人罹難
zh.summary: 土耳其空軍一架AS-532直升機11月24日在西北部艾斯基瑟希爾省執行訓練飛行時墜毀，機上5名軍人全部罹難，墜毀原因目前不明。
body: 根據土耳其國防部說法，這架直升機自土耳其西北部艾斯基瑟希爾省起飛執行訓練飛行，隨後墜毀。搜救隊伍在現場發現AS-532直升機殘骸，國防部確認機上5名軍人全部罹難，墜毀原因目前仍不明。
這是土耳其約兩週內第二起軍用直升機事故。11月12日，一架S-70軍用直升機在土耳其東部馬拉蒂亞省墜毀，機上4名軍人全部罹難。
